subject: babaYagaHut

Category: Diorama.
Subject: Baba Yaga's hut on chicken legs.
Style: Slavic folk art.

spec.name: Baba Yaga's Hut
spec.description: A Slavic folk-art diorama of a carved wooden izba standing on two giant scaly chicken legs, with a fenced yard of skull posts, a stump stair and a mortar and pestle.
spec.layout: The hut is a squat log cabin raised on two huge yellow chicken legs, with the front door facing +Z. The legs stand on a low round earth mound at the floor (mound radius 1.7, centred x=0, z=0). The cabin sits on a floor platform at y=1.2, and a steep two-slope shingled roof with a carved ridge horse-head at the front tops it. Carved folk-art window frames in red, blue and white with flower motifs flank the door. A small porch with a ladder-like stair reaches down from the door toward +Z, ending on the mound. Around the mound stands a ring of picket fence with glowing skull posts, a mortar and pestle sits at the front left, and a birch tree stands at the back right. Style: bold flat colours, ornate repeated sunburst, flower and zigzag trim motifs in red, white, and gold on every wooden surface, with chunky, blocky shapes.

parts.builds: The round earth mound (moss patches, a few stones) and the two huge chicken legs: each a thick yellow scaly tube with thigh, drumstick and shin segments (alternating legYellow and legDark scale bands), a bent knee, and a foot with three forward toes and one rear toe, each with a dark claw. Includes the gnarled crossbeam hip sockets that go up under the cabin floor at the legHip mounts.
parts.attaches: Leg tops meet the cabin underside at legHipL and legHipR (y 1.2). Feet at footL and footR on the mound.

parts.builds: The log cabin body from y=1.2 to y=2.35: stacked horizontal round logs with protruding corner-notch log ends (logEnd discs), a floor platform slab, carved door (trimRed frame, gold sunburst, iron hinges and ring handle) at doorBase on the front, two side windows plus one front window each with blue and white carved frames, flower motifs, glowing windowGlow panes and shutters. Includes the small porch deck, two posts with carved tops, and a stair of three steps descending from porchEdge toward +Z.
parts.attaches: Sits on the leg hips at cabinFloor; the roof starts at roofEave; the stair ends near yardFront.

parts.builds: The steep gabled roof from y=2.35 to 3.4 overhanging the walls: rows of overlapping shingle slabs alternating roofShingle and roofShingleDark, bargeboards with zigzag trim in trimRed and trimWhite, a front gable with a carved round window and sunburst, a ridge beam ending in a carved horse-head (ridgeFront) with gold mane, small gold finials on the rear, and a crooked clay chimney with a little smoke puff.
parts.attaches: Eaves rest on the cabin walls at roofEave. Horse-head at ridgeFront.

parts.builds: The yard dressing on the floor: a ring of picket fence posts around the mound radius ~1.75 with gaps at the front for the stair, with pointed tops in fence colour; every fourth post is a taller skull post with a skullBone skull (cranium, jaw, two glowing glowEye sockets). Also a mortar and pestle (iron mortar, long wooden pestle) at front left (x 1.5, z 1.3), and a stump with a mushroom or two.
parts.attaches: Fence is placed outside the mound edge; the stair end at yardFront remains clear between posts.

parts.builds: A tall slender birch tree at the back right (x 1.5, z -1.5) rising behind the hut to about 3.4 m: white trunk of stacked tapered segments with dark birchMark dashes, three bare branches, and clusters of faceted leaf blobs in leaf and moss colours, plus a small crow perched on a branch. A tuft of grass and two stones at the base.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor beside the fence ring, behind the roof's rear corner.
